title: Import data
fieldNameHint: For example Customers 2026. You can create as many imports as you need.
sourceFileBody: Upload a .xlsx or .csv file. Upload again later to update the same import.
sourceSheetBody: A sheet shared with anyone who has the link. NIVO can read it again on a schedule.
sourceManualBody: Paste a table copied from Excel or type rows into a small grid.
sourceDocumentBody: Word, PDF, text or Markdown files, or a Google Docs link. Each becomes a document.
filePrompt: Drop a .xlsx or .csv file here, or choose one (up to 10 MB, 20,000 rows).
linkSheetHint: Share the sheet first: Share, then Anyone with the link. Add #gid=... to read a specific tab.
linkDocHint: Share the document with anyone who has the link.
docsPrompt: Drop .docx, .pdf, .txt or .md files here, or choose them (up to 10 MB each).
docsOr: Or read a Google Docs document instead.
docsNote: A file with the same name replaces the earlier one.
pasteHint: Copy cells in Excel or Google Sheets and paste. The first row holds the column names.
gridTooBig: The table is large. Use a file for more than 1,000 rows.
mapMissing: These columns are missing from the new data: {columns}. Choose the replacement columns below, or go back and upload the right file.
mapIntro: Check how the columns are read. The first rows are shown below.
mapIdHint: Rows with the same id are updated instead of added again. The row number is used when no column is unique.
mapTitleHint: What each row is called in lists and search.
mapDateHint: Optional. Used to sort rows by time.
importSkipped: {n} rows without an id were skipped.
needNameEntity: Enter a name for the import.
needDocs: Choose a document or paste a Google Docs link.
needSheetEmpty: The grid has no rows yet.
tooBig: That file is larger than 10 MB.
